# Setup R environement 
install the necessary packages. Do this only once 
```r 
install.packages('tidyverse', 'glue',  'effectsize','wesanderson', 'dabestr', 'oro.nifti', 'abind', 'nat')
```


# Load packages 
```r
#General utility packages
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)

#Stats packages
library(effectsize)

# read nifti / nrrd
library(oro.nifti)
library(abind)
library(nat)
```

```r
sessionInfo()
```

## Pre condition
```r 

template <- readNIfTI('assets/nifti/template/template_50.nii.gz')

design <- read_csv('assets/nifti/pre/design.csv')
img <- readNIfTI('assets/nifti/pre/heatmaps_rs_smooth.nii.gz')
mask_img <- readNIfTI('assets/nifti/pre/mask_corr.nii.gz')
stat_img <- mask_img
res_img <- mask_img
suc_img <- mask_img

mask_bool <- which(mask_img[,,] == 1,arr.ind = TRUE)

img_corr<-c()
for(iter in 1:dim(img)[4]){
  print(iter)
  tmp_img<-img[,,,iter]
  tmp_img<-img[,,,iter]/mean(tmp_img[mask_img==1])
  img_corr<-abind::abind(img_corr,tmp_img, along=4)
}

for(iter  in 1:dim(mask_bool)[1]){
  
i<-  mask_bool[iter,]
g <- hedges_g(img_corr[i[1],i[2],i[3],] ~ design$Group)
stat_img[i[1],i[2],i[3]] <- g$Hedges_g

res_img[i[1],i[2],i[3]] <- mean(img_corr[i[1],i[2],i[3],design$Group == 'Resilient'])
suc_img[i[1],i[2],i[3]] <- mean(img_corr[i[1],i[2],i[3],design$Group == 'PTSD-like'])
}

writeNIfTI(stat_img,'assets/nifti/pre/pre_effect_corr')
writeNIfTI(res_img,'assets/nifti/pre/pre_res_corr')
writeNIfTI(suc_img,'assets/nifti/pre/pre_suc_corr')

```

## ROI wise clustering 

```r

# read the roi and atlas file. 
roi.list<-read_csv2('assets/script/Regions_IDs_split.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)
pre_orig_raw<-read_csv('assets/orig_Marloes/pre_raw.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)
peri_orig_raw<-read_csv('assets/orig_Marloes/peri_raw.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)
post_orig_raw<-read_csv('assets/orig_Marloes/post_raw.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)

peri_orig_raw <- peri_orig_raw[-1,]
post_orig_raw <- post_orig_raw[-1,]

peri_orig_cluster <- peri_orig_raw[0,] %>% select(-id, -structure_order, -parent_id)
post_orig_cluster <- post_orig_raw[0,] %>% select(-id, -structure_order, -parent_id)


#apply correction of the mean across ROI

peri_orig_cormean<-peri_orig_raw %>% select(-id, -structure_order, -parent_id,-name) %>% mapply("/", ., colSums(.)) %>% as.tibble()   %>% mutate(name=pre_orig_raw$name)
post_orig_cormean<-post_orig_raw %>% select(-id, -structure_order, -parent_id,-name) %>% mapply("/", ., colSums(.)) %>% as.tibble()   %>% mutate(name=pre_orig_raw$name)


#addressing email of 29/8/2024

# cluster the cell counts. 
ii<-1

     ii<-ii+1
```

## plot the Hedges'g for each ROI cluster and for each condition
```r 

#load cluster data
pre_orig_cluster_cormeansd <- read_csv('assets/table/pre_roi_cluster.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) 
peri_orig_cluster_cormeansd <- read_csv('assets/table/peri_roi_cluster.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) 
post_orig_cluster_cormeansd <- read_csv('assets/table/post_roi_cluster.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) 

#load design matrices
pre_design <- read_csv('assets/nifti/pre/design.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename('ID'=`Animal ID`)
peri_design <- read_csv('assets/nifti/peri/design.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename('ID'='Brain')
post_design <- read_csv('assets/nifti/post/design.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename('ID'='Brain')


cluster<-read_csv2('assets/script/roi_cluster_march22.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)

# cluster the cell counts. 

cluster_unique<-unique(cluster$Name) %>% as_tibble() %>% rename('name'='value') %>% add_column(pre=NA,pre_L=NA, pre_U=NA, peri=NA, peri_L=NA, peri_U=NA,post=NA,post_L=NA,post_U=NA)

for(i in 1:dim(cluster_unique)[1]){

      pre_array<-pre_orig_cluster_cormeansd[i,-1] %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% drop_na()
      if(sum(pre_array$V1==0)!=length(pre_array$V1)){
        pre_array$ID<-rownames(pre_array)
        pre_g<-merge(pre_array,pre_design,'ID') %>% hedges_g(V1~Group,data=., ci=0.90)
        cluster_unique$pre[i]<-pre_g$Hedges_g
        cluster_unique$pre_L[i]<-pre_g$CI_low
        cluster_unique$pre_U[i]<-pre_g$CI_high
      }
      
      peri_array<-peri_orig_cluster_cormeansd[i,-1] %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% drop_na()
      if(sum(peri_array$V1==0)!=length(peri_array$V1)){
        peri_array$ID<-rownames(peri_array)
        peri_g<-merge(peri_array,peri_design,'ID')  %>%  hedges_g(V1~Group,data=., ci=0.90)
        cluster_unique$peri[i]<-peri_g$Hedges_g
        cluster_unique$peri_L[i]<-peri_g$CI_low
        cluster_unique$peri_U[i]<-peri_g$CI_high
      }
      
      post_array<-post_orig_cluster_cormeansd[i,-1] %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% drop_na()
      if(sum(post_array$V1==0)!=length(post_array$V1)){
        post_array$ID<-rownames(post_array)
        post_g<-merge(post_array,post_design,'ID') %>% hedges_g(V1~Group,data=., ci=0.90)
        cluster_unique$post[i]<-post_g$Hedges_g
        cluster_unique$post_L[i]<-post_g$CI_low
        cluster_unique$post_U[i]<-post_g$CI_high
      }
      
}


cluster_unique %>% write_csv('assets/table/roi_cluster_stat.csv') 

cluster_unique$name <- factor(cluster_unique$name, levels = cluster_unique$name)

# uncomment if you want threshold-based alpha in the plots.
#thres<-0.8
#cluster_unique$pre_thr<-ifelse(abs(cluster_unique$pre)>thres,1,0.5)
#cluster_unique$peri_thr<-ifelse(abs(cluster_unique$peri)>thres,1,0.5)
#cluster_unique$post_thr<-ifelse(abs(cluster_unique$post)>thres,1,0.5)

# uncomment if you want alpha in plots based on CI
cluster_unique$pre_thr<-ifelse((cluster_unique$pre_L > 0 & cluster_unique$pre_U > 0) | (cluster_unique$pre_L < 0 & cluster_unique$pre_U < 0),1,0.5)
cluster_unique$peri_thr<-ifelse((cluster_unique$peri_L > 0 & cluster_unique$peri_U > 0) | (cluster_unique$peri_L < 0 & cluster_unique$peri_U < 0),1,0.5)
cluster_unique$post_thr<-ifelse((cluster_unique$post_L > 0 & cluster_unique$post_U > 0) | (cluster_unique$post_L < 0 & cluster_unique$post_U < 0),1,0.5)

p_pre<-ggplot(cluster_unique,aes(x=name,y=pre,alpha=pre_thr,fill=as.factor(sign(pre))))
p_pre_plot<- p_pre+geom_bar(stat = 'identity')+scale_fill_manual(values=c("1"="#c3834aff","-1"="#44708fff"))+ylim(-1.7,1.7)+theme_classic()+ theme(legend.position = "none")+
  theme(text=element_text(size=6),axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90 ))+labs(x='',y=bquote("Hedge's g"))
 
 ggsave('assets/figure/pre_roi_all.svg',plot = p_pre_plot,device='svg',units='mm', dpi=300, width=120, height=100)
 
 p_peri<-ggplot(cluster_unique,aes(x=name,y=peri,alpha=peri_thr,fill=as.factor(sign(peri))))
p_peri_plot<- p_peri+geom_bar(stat = 'identity')+scale_fill_manual(values=c("1"="#c3834aff","-1"="#44708fff"))+ylim(-1.7,1.7)+theme_classic()+ theme(legend.position = "none")+
  theme(text=element_text(size=6),axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90 ))+labs(x='',y=bquote("Hedge's g"))
 
 ggsave('assets/figure/peri_roi_all.svg',plot = p_peri_plot,device='svg',units='mm', dpi=300, width=120, height=100)
 
 p_post<-ggplot(cluster_unique,aes(x=name,y=post,alpha=post_thr,fill=as.factor(sign(post))))
p_post_plot<- p_post+geom_bar(stat = 'identity')+scale_fill_manual(values=c("1"="#c3834aff","-1"="#44708fff"))+ylim(-1.7,1.7)+theme_classic()+ theme(legend.position = "none")+
  theme(text=element_text(size=6),axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90 ))+labs(x='',y=bquote("Hedge's g"))
 
 ggsave('assets/figure/post_roi_all.svg',plot = p_post_plot,device='svg',units='mm', dpi=300, width=120, height=100)
```


# Show selected ROI using garner plots 

```{r}

library(gdata)

#ROIs to plot
#Pre-trauma: lOrb 26, mPAL 71 
#Peri-trauma: pVis 19 & dRSP 33
#Post-trauma: lOrb & dRSP 33

#load cluster data
pre_orig_cluster_cormeansd <- read_csv('assets/table/pre_roi_cluster.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) 
peri_orig_cluster_cormeansd <- read_csv('assets/table/peri_roi_cluster.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) 
post_orig_cluster_cormeansd <- read_csv('assets/table/post_roi_cluster.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) 

#load design matrices
pre_design <- read_csv('assets/nifti/pre/design.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename('ID'=`Animal ID`)
peri_design <- read_csv('assets/nifti/peri/design.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename('ID'='Brain')
post_design <- read_csv('assets/nifti/post/design.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename('ID'='Brain')

cluster_unique <- read_csv('assets/table/roi_cluster_stat.csv') 

cluster_unique$name <- factor(cluster_unique$name, levels = cluster_unique$name)

i_list<-c(19, 26, 33, 71)
for(i in i_list){
pre_array<-pre_orig_cluster_cormeansd[i,-1] %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% drop_na()
pre_array$ID<-rownames(pre_array)
roi_id<-cluster_unique$name[i]
pre_g<-merge(pre_array,pre_design,'ID') %>% mutate(Condition='pre') %>% select(V1,Group,Condition)
cbindX(tibble('Resilient'=pre_g$V1[pre_g$Group=='Resilient']),tibble('Susceptible'=pre_g$V1[pre_g$Group=='PTSD-like'])) %>% write_csv(glue('assets/table/dabest/pre_{roi_id}.csv'))

        
peri_array<-peri_orig_cluster_cormeansd[i,-1] %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% drop_na()
peri_array$ID<-rownames(peri_array)
peri_g<-merge(peri_array,peri_design,'ID') %>% mutate(Condition='peri') %>% select(V1,Group,Condition)
cbindX(tibble('Resilient'=peri_g$V1[peri_g$Group=='Resilient']),tibble('Susceptible'=peri_g$V1[peri_g$Group=='PTSD-like'])) %>% write_csv(glue('assets/table/dabest/peri_{roi_id}.csv'))


post_array<-post_orig_cluster_cormeansd[i,-1] %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% drop_na()
post_array$ID<-rownames(post_array)
post_g<-merge(post_array,post_design,'ID') %>% mutate(Condition='post') %>% select(V1,Group,Condition)
cbindX(tibble('Resilient'=post_g$V1[post_g$Group=='Resilient']),tibble('Susceptible'=post_g$V1[post_g$Group=='PTSD-like'])) %>% write_csv(glue('assets/table/dabest/post_{roi_id}.csv'))


}


```

### perform interaction effect betwee pre and peri.  (to be completed)
```r
library(effectsize)
library(multcomp)
library(parameters)

pre_orig_cluster_cormeansd <- read_csv('assets/table/pre_roi_cluster.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) 
peri_orig_cluster_cormeansd <- read_csv('assets/table/peri_roi_cluster.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) 
post_orig_cluster_cormeansd <- read_csv('assets/table/post_roi_cluster.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) 

#load design matrices
pre_design <- read_csv('assets/nifti/pre/design.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename('ID'=`Animal ID`)
peri_design <- read_csv('assets/nifti/peri/design.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename('ID'='Brain')
post_design <- read_csv('assets/nifti/post/design.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename('ID'='Brain')


cluster<-read_csv2('assets/script/roi_cluster_march22.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)

# cluster the cell counts. 

#adding peripre tests to address email of 29/8/2024
cluster_unique<-unique(cluster$Name) %>% as_tibble() %>% rename('name'='value') %>% add_column(stress=NA,stress_L=NA, stress_U=NA, inter=NA, inter_L=NA, inter_U=NA, peripre_res=NA, peripre_res_L=NA, peripre_res_U=NA, peripre_ptsd=NA, peripre_ptsd_L=NA, peripre_ptsd_U=NA)

for(i in 1:dim(cluster_unique)[1]){

      pre_array<-pre_orig_cluster_cormeansd[i,-1] %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% drop_na()
      peri_array<-peri_orig_cluster_cormeansd[i,-1] %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% drop_na()
      post_array<-post_orig_cluster_cormeansd[i,-1] %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% drop_na()
      
      if(sum(pre_array$V1==0)!=length(pre_array$V1) & sum(peri_array$V1==0)!=length(peri_array$V1) & sum(post_array$V1==0)!=length(post_array$V1)){
        pre_array$ID<-rownames(pre_array)
        pre_array<-merge(pre_array,pre_design,'ID') %>% mutate(Condition='pre') %>% dplyr::select(V1,Group,Condition) 
        
        peri_array$ID<-rownames(peri_array)
        peri_array<-merge(peri_array,peri_design,'ID')  %>% mutate(Condition='peri') %>% dplyr::select(V1,Group,Condition) 
        
        post_array$ID<-rownames(post_array)
        post_array<-merge(post_array,post_design,'ID') %>% mutate(Condition='post') %>% dplyr::select(V1,Group,Condition) 

        # merge the three dataframes
        #df<-rbind(pre_array,peri_array) %>% unite(Condition_group,c(Condition,Group)) %>% mutate(Condition_group=as.factor(Condition_group))
        df<-rbind(pre_array,peri_array) %>% mutate(Condition=as.factor(Condition), Group=as.factor(Group))


        #mod<-lm(V1~Condition_group, data=df)
        #K <- rbind(c( 1, 1, -1, -1), 
        #            c(1,  -1,  -1, 1)) 

        #top <- glht(mod, linfct = mcp(Condition_group = K))  %>% confint(level=0.9)

        mod<-lm(V1~Condition*Group, data=df)
        model_parameters <- model_parameters(mod, standardize = 'refit',ci=0.9)

        #cluster_unique$stress[i]<-top$confint[1,1]
        #cluster_unique$stress_L[i]<-top$confint[1,2]
        #cluster_unique$stress_U[i]<-top$confint[1,3]

        #cluster_unique$inter[i]<-top$confint[2,1]
        #cluster_unique$inter_L[i]<-top$confint[2,2]
        #cluster_unique$inter_U[i]<-top$confint[2,3]

        cluster_unique$stress[i]<-model_parameters$Coefficient[2]
        cluster_unique$stress_L[i]<-model_parameters$CI_low[2]
        cluster_unique$stress_U[i]<-model_parameters$CI_high[2]

        cluster_unique$inter[i]<-model_parameters$Coefficient[4]
        cluster_unique$inter_L[i]<-model_parameters$CI_low[4]
        cluster_unique$inter_U[i]<-model_parameters$CI_high[4]
        
        g <- hedges_g(df$V1[df$Condition=='peri' & df$Group=='Resilient'], df$V1[df$Condition=='pre' & df$Group=='Resilient'])
        cluster_unique$peripre_res[i]<-g$Hedges_g
        cluster_unique$peripre_res_L[i]<-g$CI_low
        cluster_unique$peripre_res_U[i]<-g$CI_high

        g <- hedges_g(df$V1[df$Condition=='peri' & df$Group=='PTSD-like'], df$V1[df$Condition=='pre' & df$Group=='PTSD-like'])
        cluster_unique$peripre_ptsd[i]<-g$Hedges_g
        cluster_unique$peripre_ptsd_L[i]<-g$CI_low
        cluster_unique$peripre_ptsd_U[i]<-g$CI_high


      }
}
```

### plot ROI grouped by network 
```r
pal<-c('#44708fff','#ffffff','#c3834aff')
thres<-0.8

# read the roi and atlas file. 
roi.list<-read_csv2('assets/script/Regions_IDs_split.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)
pre_orig_raw<-read_csv('assets/orig_Marloes/pre_raw.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)
peri_orig_raw<-read_csv('assets/orig_Marloes/peri_raw.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)
post_orig_raw<-read_csv('assets/orig_Marloes/post_raw.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)
cluster<-read_csv2('assets/script/roi_network_march22.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename(id=ID)
cluster_legacy<-read_csv2('assets/script/roi_cluster_march22.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename(id=ID, cluster_legacy=Cluster, name_legacy=Name)


#merge cluster and cluger_legacy by id
cluster<-left_join(cluster,cluster_legacy,by='id') %>% arrange(Network,cluster_legacy)

#remove cell count from background. 
pre_orig_raw <- pre_orig_raw[-1,]
peri_orig_raw <- peri_orig_raw[-1,]
post_orig_raw <- post_orig_raw[-1,]

pre_orig_cluster <- pre_orig_raw[0,] %>% select(-id, -structure_order, -parent_id) %>% add_column(network=NA,.before=names(.)[1]) %>% mutate(network=as.character(network))
peri_orig_cluster <- peri_orig_raw[0,] %>% select(-id, -structure_order, -parent_id) %>% add_column(network=NA,.before=names(.)[1]) %>% mutate(network=as.character(network))
post_orig_cluster <- post_orig_raw[0,] %>% select(-id, -structure_order, -parent_id) %>% add_column(network=NA,.before=names(.)[1]) %>% mutate(network=as.character(network))


pre_id<-names(pre_orig_cluster)[-1:-4] %>% as.double
peri_id<-names(peri_orig_cluster)[-1:-4] %>% as.double
post_id<-names(post_orig_cluster)[-1:-4] %>% as.double

#apply correction of the mean across ROI
pre_orig_cormean<-pre_orig_raw %>% select(-id, -structure_order, -parent_id,-name) %>% mapply("/", ., colSums(.)) %>% as.tibble()   %>% mutate(name=pre_orig_raw$name)
peri_orig_cormean<-peri_orig_raw %>% select(-id, -structure_order, -parent_id,-name) %>% mapply("/", ., colSums(.)) %>% as.tibble()   %>% mutate(name=pre_orig_raw$name)
post_orig_cormean<-post_orig_raw %>% select(-id, -structure_order, -parent_id,-name) %>% mapply("/", ., colSums(.)) %>% as.tibble()   %>% mutate(name=pre_orig_raw$name)


#load design matrices
pre_design <- read_csv('assets/nifti/pre/design.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename('ID'=`Animal ID`)
peri_design <- read_csv('assets/nifti/peri/design.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename('ID'='Brain')
post_design <- read_csv('assets/nifti/post/design.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename('ID'='Brain')

cluster_unique<- cluster %>% distinct(Name,.keep_all = TRUE) %>% add_column(pre=NA,pre_L=NA, pre_U=NA, peri=NA, peri_L=NA, peri_U=NA,post=NA,post_L=NA,post_U=NA)


for(i in 1:dim(cluster_unique)[1]){
  name<-cluster_unique$Name[i]
  ID_list<-cluster$id[cluster$Name==name]
  network<-cluster$Network[cluster$Name==name]%>% na.omit() %>% .[1]
  name_list<-roi.list$name[roi.list$id %in% ID_list]
  #print(name)
  pre_orig_cluster[i,]<-pre_orig_cormean %>%  
    filter(grepl(paste(name_list, collapse="|"), name)) %>% 
    select(-name) %>% 
    summarise_each(funs(sum(., na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
    add_column('network'=network, .before=names(.)[1])  %>% 
    add_column('name'=name, .before=names(.)[2])
    
    pre_array<- pre_orig_cluster[i,-1:-2] %>% t %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column('ID') %>% mutate(ID=as.double(ID)) %>% rename('value'='V1') %>% left_join(pre_design,by='ID')
    pre_g<- pre_array %>% hedges_g(value~Group,data=.,ci=0.90)
    cluster_unique$pre[i]<-pre_g$Hedges_g
    cluster_unique$pre_L[i]<-pre_g$CI_low
    cluster_unique$pre_U[i]<-pre_g$CI_high

  peri_orig_cluster[i,]<-peri_orig_cormean %>%  
    filter(grepl(paste(name_list, collapse="|"), name)) %>% 
    select(-name) %>% 
    summarise_each(funs(sum(., na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
    add_column('network'=network, .before=names(.)[1])  %>% 
    add_column('name'=name, .before=names(.)[2])
 
    peri_array<- peri_orig_cluster[i,-1:-2] %>% t %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column('ID') %>% mutate(ID=as.double(ID)) %>% rename('value'='V1') %>% left_join(peri_design,by='ID')
    peri_g<- peri_array %>% hedges_g(value~Group,data=.,ci=0.90)
    cluster_unique$peri[i]<-peri_g$Hedges_g
    cluster_unique$peri_L[i]<-peri_g$CI_low
    cluster_unique$peri_U[i]<-peri_g$CI_high
 
  post_orig_cluster[i,]<-post_orig_cormean %>%  
    filter(grepl(paste(name_list, collapse="|"), name)) %>% 
    select(-name) %>% 
    summarise_each(funs(sum(., na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
    add_column('network'=network, .before=names(.)[1])  %>% 
    add_column('name'=name, .before=names(.)[2])
    
    post_array<- post_orig_cluster[i,-1:-2] %>% t %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column('ID') %>% mutate(ID=as.double(ID)) %>% rename('value'='V1') %>% left_join(post_design,by='ID')
    post_g<- post_array %>% hedges_g(value~Group,data=.,ci=0.90)
    cluster_unique$post[i]<-post_g$Hedges_g
    cluster_unique$post_L[i]<-post_g$CI_low
    cluster_unique$post_U[i]<-post_g$CI_high
   
}

#merge cluster_unique and cluster by name and Name
cluster_unique <- cluster_unique %>% mutate(net_id = case_when(Network == 'DMN' ~ 1, Network == 'SN' ~ 2, Network == 'LCN' ~ 3)) %>% 
                  arrange(net_id, cluster_legacy) 

cluster_unique$Name <- factor(cluster_unique$Name, levels = cluster_unique$Name)


# uncomment if you want threshold-based alpha in the plots.

cluster_unique$peri_thr<-ifelse((cluster_unique$peri_L > 0 & cluster_unique$peri_U > 0) | (cluster_unique$peri_L < 0 & cluster_unique$peri_U < 0),1,0.5)
cluster_unique$post_thr<-ifelse((cluster_unique$post_L > 0 & cluster_unique$post_U > 0) | (cluster_unique$post_L < 0 & cluster_unique$post_U < 0),1,0.5)

p_pre<-ggplot(cluster_unique,aes(x=Name,y=pre,alpha=pre_thr,fill=as.factor(sign(pre))))
p_pre_plot<- p_pre+geom_bar(stat = 'identity')+scale_fill_manual(values=c("1"="#c3834aff","-1"="#44708fff"))+ylim(-1.7,1.7)+theme_classic()+ theme(legend.position = "none")+
  theme(text=element_text(size=6),axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90 ))+labs(x='',y=bquote("Hedge's g"))
 
 ggsave('assets/figure/pre_roi_network.svg',plot = p_pre_plot,device='svg',units='mm', dpi=300, width=120, height=100)

  theme(text=element_text(size=6),axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90 ))+labs(x='',y=bquote("Hedge's g"))
 
 ggsave('assets/figure/peri_roi_network.svg',plot = p_peri_plot,device='svg',units='mm', dpi=300, width=120, height=100)
 
 p_post<-ggplot(cluster_unique,aes(x=Name,y=post,alpha=post_thr,fill=as.factor(sign(post))))
p_post_plot<- p_post+geom_bar(stat = 'identity')+scale_fill_manual(values=c("1"="#c3834aff","-1"="#44708fff"))+ylim(-1.7,1.7)+theme_classic()+ theme(legend.position = "none")+
```

```r 
                           pre_g=as.double(pre_g),

                           peri_U=as.double(peri_U),
                           post_g=as.double(post_g),
                           post_L=as.double(post_L),
                           post_U=as.double(post_U),
                           res_mean=as.double(res_mean),

# now we do the second part
d2.pre_res <- reshape2::melt(pre_res_cor, c("x", "y"), value.name = "z") %>% filter(.$y < .$x)
d2.pre_res<-d2.pre_res %>% left_join(network.df, by = 'x') %>% rename(y=y.x, networkx=network) %>% select(-y.y) %>% left_join(network.df, by = 'y')%>% rename(x=x.x,networky=network) %>% select(-x.y) %>% mutate(networkpair=paste(.$networky,.$networkx,sep='.'))

for(i in 1:length(unique(d2.pre_res$networkpair))){
  cor.df<-cor.df %>% add_row(network=unique(d2.pre_res$networkpair)[i],
                             pre_g=hedges_g(d2.pre_ptsd$z[d2.pre_ptsd$networkpair==unique(d2.pre_res$networkpair)[i]],d2.pre_res$z[d2.pre_res$networkpair==unique(d2.pre_res$networkpair)[i]], ci=0.90)$Hedges_g,
                             pre_L=hedges_g(d2.pre_ptsd$z[d2.pre_ptsd$networkpair==unique(d2.pre_res$networkpair)[i]],d2.pre_res$z[d2.pre_res$networkpair==unique(d2.pre_res$networkpair)[i]], ci=0.90)$CI_low,
                             pre_U=hedges_g(d2.pre_ptsd$z[d2.pre_ptsd$networkpair==unique(d2.pre_res$networkpair)[i]],d2.pre_res$z[d2.pre_res$networkpair==unique(d2.pre_res$networkpair)[i]], ci=0.90)$CI_high,
                             
                             peri_g=hedges_g(d2.peri_ptsd$z[d2.peri_ptsd$networkpair==unique(d2.peri_res$networkpair)[i]],d2.peri_res$z[d2.peri_res$networkpair==unique(d2.peri_res$networkpair)[i]], ci=0.90)$Hedges_g,
                             peri_L=hedges_g(d2.peri_ptsd$z[d2.peri_ptsd$networkpair==unique(d2.peri_res$networkpair)[i]],d2.peri_res$z[d2.peri_res$networkpair==unique(d2.peri_res$networkpair)[i]], ci=0.90)$CI_low,
                             peri_U=hedges_g(d2.peri_ptsd$z[d2.peri_ptsd$networkpair==unique(d2.peri_res$networkpair)[i]],d2.peri_res$z[d2.peri_res$networkpair==unique(d2.peri_res$networkpair)[i]], ci=0.90)$CI_high,

                             res_g=hedges_g(c(d2.pre_res$z[d2.pre_res$networkpair==unique(d2.pre_res$networkpair)[i]],

                                            d2.post_res$z[d2.post_res$networkpair==unique(d2.post_res$networkpair)[i]]), ci=0.90)$Hedges_g,
                             res_L=hedges_g(c(d2.pre_res$z[d2.pre_res$networkpair==unique(d2.pre_res$networkpair)[i]],

                             res_U=hedges_g(c(d2.pre_res$z[d2.pre_res$networkpair==unique(d2.pre_res$networkpair)[i]],

                                            d2.post_res$z[d2.post_res$networkpair==unique(d2.post_res$networkpair)[i]]), ci=0.90)$CI_high
)

}

thres<-0.4
cor.df$pre_thr<-ifelse(abs(cor.df$pre_g)>thres,1,0.5)
cor.df$peri_thr<-ifelse(abs(cor.df$peri_g)>thres,1,0.5)
cor.df$post_thr<-ifelse(abs(cor.df$post_g)>thres,1,0.5)

# uncomment if you want alpha in plots based on CI
cor.df$pre_thr<-ifelse((cor.df$pre_L > 0 & cor.df$pre_U > 0) | (cor.df$pre_L < 0 & cor.df$pre_U < 0),1,0.5)
cor.df$peri_thr<-ifelse((cor.df$peri_L > 0 & cor.df$peri_U > 0) | (cor.df$peri_L < 0 & cor.df$peri_U < 0),1,0.5)
cor.df$post_thr<-ifelse((cor.df$post_L > 0 & cor.df$post_U > 0) | (cor.df$post_L < 0 & cor.df$post_U < 0),1,0.5)
```

```r
roi.list<-read_csv2('assets/script/Regions_IDs_split.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)
pre_orig_raw<-read_csv('assets/orig_Marloes/pre_raw.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)
peri_orig_raw<-read_csv('assets/orig_Marloes/peri_raw.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)
post_orig_raw<-read_csv('assets/orig_Marloes/post_raw.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)
cluster<-read_csv2('assets/script/roi_network_march22.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename(id=ID)
cluster_legacy<-read_csv2('assets/script/roi_cluster_march22.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename(id=ID, cluster_legacy=Cluster, name_legacy=Name)


#merge cluster and cluger_legacy by id
cluster<-left_join(cluster,cluster_legacy,by='id') %>% arrange(Network,cluster_legacy)

#remove cell count from background. 
pre_orig_raw <- pre_orig_raw[-1,]
peri_orig_raw <- peri_orig_raw[-1,]
post_orig_raw <- post_orig_raw[-1,]

pre_orig_cluster <- pre_orig_raw[0,] %>% select(-id, -structure_order, -parent_id, -name)  %>% add_column(network=NA,.before=names(.)[1]) %>% mutate(network=as.character(network)) 
peri_orig_cluster <- peri_orig_raw[0,] %>% select(-id, -structure_order, -parent_id, -name)  %>% add_column(network=NA,.before=names(.)[1]) %>% mutate(network=as.character(network))
post_orig_cluster <- post_orig_raw[0,] %>% select(-id, -structure_order, -parent_id, -name) %>% add_column(network=NA,.before=names(.)[1]) %>% mutate(network=as.character(network))


#apply correction of the mean across ROI
pre_orig_cormean<-pre_orig_raw %>% select(-id, -structure_order, -parent_id,-name) %>% mapply("/", ., colSums(.)) %>% as.tibble()   %>% mutate(name=pre_orig_raw$name)
peri_orig_cormean<-peri_orig_raw %>% select(-id, -structure_order, -parent_id,-name) %>% mapply("/", ., colSums(.)) %>% as.tibble()   %>% mutate(name=pre_orig_raw$name)
post_orig_cormean<-post_orig_raw %>% select(-id, -structure_order, -parent_id,-name) %>% mapply("/", ., colSums(.)) %>% as.tibble()   %>% mutate(name=pre_orig_raw$name)


#load design matrices
pre_design <- read_csv('assets/nifti/pre/design.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename('ID'=`Animal ID`)
peri_design <- read_csv('assets/nifti/peri/design.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename('ID'='Brain')
post_design <- read_csv('assets/nifti/post/design.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename('ID'='Brain')



# cluster the cell counts. 

cluster_unique<-unique(cluster$Network)

for(i in 1:length(cluster_unique)){
  network<-cluster_unique[i]
  ID_list<-cluster$id[cluster$Network==network]
  name_list<-roi.list$name[roi.list$id %in% ID_list] 
  pre_orig_cluster[i,]<-pre_orig_cormean %>%  
    filter(grepl(paste(name_list, collapse="|"), name)) %>% 
    select(-name) %>% 
    summarise_each(funs(sum(., na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    add_column('network'=network, .before=names(.)[1])   
    
  peri_orig_cluster[i,]<-peri_orig_cormean %>%  
    filter(grepl(paste(name_list, collapse="|"), name)) %>% 
    select(-name) %>% 
    summarise_each(funs(sum(., na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
    add_column('network'=network, .before=names(.)[1])
  
  post_orig_cluster[i,]<-post_orig_cormean %>%  
    filter(grepl(paste(name_list, collapse="|"), name)) %>% 
    select(-name) %>% 
    summarise_each(funs(sum(., na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    add_column('network'=network, .before=names(.)[1])  
}

pre_array <- pre_orig_cluster  %>% pivot_longer(!network, names_to = "id", values_to = "count") %>% 
                                    pivot_wider(names_from='network', values_from='count') %>% 
                                    mutate(ID=as.double(id)) %>% left_join(pre_design, by='ID') 
peri_array <- peri_orig_cluster  %>% pivot_longer(!network, names_to = "id", values_to = "count") %>%
```
